name: bq-tax-system
description: Identify the tax framework for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba in 2026. Use before selecting a BES tax, taxpayer, authority, period or island ordinance. Explains statutory territorial definitions, residence, currency, national tax branches, local taxing powers and transitional liabilities. Maps the substantive BES companions and separates a power to levy from an adopted charge. Includes primary legislation and worked classification cases. This source-cited draft holds unverified island ordinances, customs detail and unresolved legal application. Load with the universal workflow base and applicable domain references; professional review remains required.
